entities.name: Andrus Kivirähk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrus Kivirähk is an Estonian writer, a playwright, topical satirist, and screenwriter. As of 2004, 25,000 copies of his novel Rehepapp ehk November had been sold, making him the most popular 21st-century Estonian writer. His book The Man Who Spoke Snakish has been one of the top selling books in Estonia. He has been a member of the Estonian Writers' Union since 1996.
